mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_history (user_id, question, answer, session_id, model_name, response_time, is_cached, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{sessionId}, #{modelName}, #{responseTime}, #{isCached}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
